subcategory_text: Use processes and tools to assign and manage authorisation to credentials for user accounts, including service accounts, administrator accounts, and vendor accounts.
implementation_examples: IG1: Use unique passwords; disable default accounts
IG2: Restrict administrator privileges; use PIM/PAM
IG3: Centralise account management; enforce MFA everywhere
assessment_objectives: Determine whether accounts are uniquely identified.
Determine whether privileged accounts are restricted.
